questions.text: Consider a 4-bit Johnson counter with an initial value of 0000. The counting sequence of this counter is
questions.solution:
A Johnson counter shifts right and feeds the complement of the last bit back to the first:

0000 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 1000 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 1100 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 1110 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 1111 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 0111 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 0011 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 0001 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 0000

In decimal: 0, 8, 12, 14, 15, 7, 3, 1, 0

Answer: 0, 8, 12, 14, 15, 7, 3, 1, 0

questions.text: Which of the following is not valid Boolean algebra rule ?
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- X[latex]\cdot[/latex]X = X (idempotent) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] valid
- (X + Y)X = X (absorption) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] valid
- [latex]\bar X+XY=\bar X+Y[/latex], not Y [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] invalid
- (X + Y)(X + Z) = X + YZ (distributive) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] valid

Answer: [latex]\bar X+XY=Y[/latex]

questions.text:
Consider the logic circuit given below.


The inverter, AND and OR gates have delays of 6, 10 and 11 nanoseconds respectively. Assuming that wire delays are negligible, what is the duration of glitch for Q before it becomes stable?
questions.solution:
Q = [latex](\bar AB)\oplus(A+C)[/latex]. A change in A reaches the XOR by two paths:

- Through NOT and AND: 6 + 10 = 16 ns
- Through OR: 11 ns

Between 11 ns and 16 ns the XOR sees one updated and one old input, giving a glitch of 16 [latex]-[/latex] 11 = 5 ns.

Answer: 5

questions.text: How many different BCD numbers can be stored in 12 switches ? (Assume two position or on-off switches).
questions.solution:
Each BCD digit needs 4 switches, so 12 switches hold 3 digits: 000 to 999.

[latex]10^3[/latex] different numbers.

Answer: [latex]10^3[/latex]

questions.text: The output of a tristate buffer when the enable input in 0 is
questions.solution:
When enable is 0, a tristate buffer goes to the high-impedance state, so the output is effectively disconnected.

Answer: Disconnected state
